entities.name: Pardia
entities.description: A mountain region on the continent Otaria on Dominaria, south of Krosa.

entities.name: Kamahl
entities.description: A barbarian from Pardia who took part in the Battle for the Mirari and was warped by the Mirari-infused sword.

entities.name: Jeska
entities.description: Kamahl's sister, who became a victim of the Battle for the Mirari.

entities.name: Balthor
entities.description: A notable person from the Pardic Mountains.

entities.name: Toggo
entities.description: A notable person from the Pardic Mountains.

entities.name: Talon
entities.description: Kamahl's greatest challenger, who took over leadership of the barbarian tribes.

entities.name: Mirari
entities.description: An artifact that warped Kamahl through its infused sword.

entities.name: Battle for the Mirari
entities.description: The 4305 AR conflict over the Mirari.

entities.name: Cabal City
entities.description: The destroyed city from which Kamahl brought the Mirari-infused sword.

entities.name: Skirk Ridge
entities.description: The area where goblins were largely restricted.

entities.name: Time Spiral crisis
entities.description: The crisis by which time the Pardic human barbarians had become extinct.

events.summary: Kamahl brings the Mirari-infused sword to Pardia and forces a challenge among barbarian clans to decide who leads them all.
events.quote: forced a challenge between any rival fighters from other barbarian clans in order to determine who would lead them all

events.summary: The barbarians refuse to follow Kamahl in his madness.
events.quote: the barbarians refused to follow him in his madness

events.summary: Kamahl gives his sister Jeska a lethal wound with his sword for trying to stop him, realizes he is warped, and cedes leadership to Talon.
events.quote: ceded the leadership over the barbarian tribes to Talon , his greatest challenger

events.summary: War returns to Pardia as the Ixidoran faith turns warlike and slays those who refuse to convert.
events.quote: war returned to Pardia, as the Ixidoran faith had turned warlike

relations.quote: his sister Jeska , who became a victim of it

relations.note: He gave her a lethal wound with his sword.
relations.quote: after he gave his sister a lethal wound with his sword for trying to stop him
Pardia is a mountain region on the continent Otaria on Dominaria .
